reuse.why: Edits the existing private helpers behind getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold; no new mechanism.

duplication.why: The rule is simplified to Math.min and amount - threshold inside the single shared helpers; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The change lives in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount rule already lived, so every consumer (api, forecast, schedules app) picks it up.

scope.why: Only the helpers, their tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Simpler code with helper names and comment updated to describe the new rule.
